notes.title: Update 0.15 "Comfort and Nations"
notes.content:
In version 0.15, the Space Corporation simulator has acquired a holistic and complete gameplay.
While previous updates were more technological in nature - construction, logistics and automation, the latest updates have brought a greater social component.
In addition to the previously added hygiene needs, various diseases and methods of their treatment, individual character traits of the staff have been added (affecting the behavior of the character and his interaction with colleagues), as well as ideologies on which the outcome of the elections in the colony and the laws that will apply in it depend. 
Strong leaders are able to win over colleagues to their side and change the ideology in the colony and change the voting results next month.
If inexperienced employees are willing to work in spartan conditions, more experienced colleagues now need increased comfort conditions, which can be provided with more expensive furniture and more individual rooms.
Even more new features became available after research - augmentations to improve staff capabilities, robots - can do most of the work for humans and do not require food or comfortable conditions, and yes, it is now possible to create an entire colony of clones mining Helium-3 on the Moon =)
The financial model, salaries and bonuses of staff, as well as Loans from gaming nations as a way to get money quickly, which will need to be repaid with interest.
Completely redesigned game nations and contracts with them make the game more exciting and more unique and balanced each time.
Finally, the game now has a story mode that gives the player not only a goal, but also the opportunity to complete the game.

Development continues and I am switching to the development of the next version 0.16.
It will redesign the user interface and optimize performance.
I ask you to send me game saves with a large number of colonies and colonies for hundreds and thousands of colonists, in which performance problems are very noticeable - this will help me optimize the game.

Have a nice game, everyone!

Full list of changes in version 0.15:
* Tourists and contract patients do not need to migrate
* fixed collisions of scientific equipment
* the display of heaters in the investigated equipment has been fixed
* fixed the reachability of large vertical beds
* fixed an error when executing the contract for the establishment of a spaceport on Venus

For players planning to continue playing the new version from the old save, I recommend making backup saves, as adapting previously created large colonies to the new mechanics may not be easy at all.

notes.title: Happy New Year 2025!
notes.content:
So the year 2024 is coming to an end, it's time to take stock and talk about future plans.

The most notable thing that has been done in a year: 
Added new cabin furniture
New resources have been added: deuterium, dirty water, medicinal herbs, medicines, grown organs, and unrelenting antibiotics.
New toilet and shower rooms have been added
Added staff skills and staff salary depending on skills
The difficulty settings have been redesigned - significantly more game parameters have been made easier on the Beginner difficulty.
The mechanics of staff health and illness have been completely redesigned. The hospital's equipment has also been updated.
New scientific equipment in the laboratory, research after which scientific equipment is opened has been changed

The open beta testing of version 0.15 has already been completed and will begin soon:
A new financial model and loans
Indoor comfort and staff comfort requirements
Contracts for mining, industrial, tourist, farming and scientific colonies and treatment of patients
with the ideology of the perosnala and elections
Character traits, leadership, and augmentations
Manufacturing and flashing of robots
Clone production
The storyline 'Solargene Mission'

I plan to release versions next year.:
0.16 Redesign of the user interface and performance optimization
1.0 Interactive learning and Early Access exit

We wish you all happiness and success in the new year!

notes.title: Happy New Year 2023!
notes.content:
So 2022 is coming to an end, and it's time to take stock and tell us about our future plans.

The most notable things that were done during the year:
[list]
[*] Before the release of the early access the game appeared a tutorial.
    Yes, it was dryly written, but it allowed many players to master the game and will be complemented by an interactive tutorial in the future (more about this below).
[*] The game has been translated into 9 languages: Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish.
    All localizations are posted online and many players have helped with the edits, for which I am eternally grateful!
[*] Game in Early Access
     With the release of the game in early access, I received a huge amount of feedback and suggestions from players, all of it recorded and serves as material for the release of new versions
[*] Added resource basket for easier purchase of materials
[*] Added horizontal slashing of buildings
[*] Game moved to newer engine version
[*] Fixed problems with staff navigation, added navigation beacons and displaying staff paths.
[*] Added separate room for servicing robots and spacious apartments
[*] Many notifications were made non-modal and do not interrupt gameplay
[*] Optimized performance especially for large colonies and reduced game size
[*] Full support for custom scripts and modifications (with uploading to Steam Steam Wizard)
[*] New interiors and individual furniture for Chinese, Japanese and European cuisine
[*] New research, new resources and equipment for their production
[*] Alternative game camera
[*] Added many new sounds
[*] Redrawn all icons
[/list]

Also in the past year, the plan for the early access release was finalized:
[b]v0.12[/b]
[list]
[*] automatic purchasing, shipping, and selling of cargo.
[*] scheduling the turning on and off of individual equipment or entire rooms
[*] separate personnel control panel
[*] automatic transfer of personnel via network of stations
[*] different sized equipment
[*] redesigned cafe Russian, American and Indian kitchens
[/list]

[b]v0.13[/b]
[list]
[*] Temperature and radiation will be redesigned and their effect on the colonies will be more significant.
[*] Natural disasters will be added (solar flares, meteor showers, dust storms, etc.)
[*] Wireless energy transfer between colonies
[/list]

[b]v0.14[/b]
[list]
[*] Hygiene - facilities, equipment and mechanics related to it
[*] Disease and medicine (injuries, pandemics, treatment methods, their impact on gameplay)
[/list]

[*] Factions/Societies/Groups and the interaction between them

[list]

[/list]

[b]v1.0[/b]
[list]
[*] interactive training

[/list]

After the early access release the game will continue to evolve and I will post further plans.

Happy and successful new year everyone!

notes.title: Update 0.11 "Modifications"
notes.content:
Now most of the game parameters (and some game mechanics) are rendered into scripts, and players can create their own modifications and share them in the Steam Workshop.
Instructions for creating modifications are supplied with the game. To create simple modifications, you do not need the ability to program or install additional programs.
Already now, with the help of modifications, you can:
1. Change the game balance (equipment parameters, composition, game constants)
2. Create new contracts, game events and scenarios
3. Change the items and equipment available for installation in each room
4. Change the parameters and composition of the solar system
In the future, the possibilities of modifying the game will expand according to the wishes of the players.

+ Carbon electronics

Antimatter mining has been transferred from the Main Asteroid Belt to the Kuiper Belt
Completely redesigned game balance
Added a feedback form to the main menu with the ability to send autosave
The premises of Chinese, Japanese and European cuisine have been redesigned. Now they have individual furniture, individual decor of walls, floors and ceilings.
Added an alternative game camera for beginners
Added a lot of new sounds
All icons have been redrawn
And much more.

The work continues and I switch to the development of version 0.12 "Automation". Along with this in the game will appear:
1. automatic purchase, shipment and sale of goods.
2. planning of switching on and off of individual equipment or premises as a whole
3. separate personnel management panel

Follow the news and have a nice game to everyone!

notes.title: Happy New Year 2022!
notes.content:
So, the year 2021 is coming to an end, what interesting things happened in cosmonautics in it?
- The Perseverance and Zhu Rong rovers have joined Curiosity in exploring the surface of Mars
- The Hope spacecraft has entered the orbit of Mars
-Ingenuity spacecraft, the first helicopter to fly on another planet, entered the orbit of Mars
- The first module of the Chinese near-Earth station has been launched 
- A new module "SCIENCE" has been docked to the ISS and started functioning
- Two private companies have sent and returned tourists from space at once: SpaceX and Blue Origin
- The IXPE X-ray telescope has been launched
- And probably the most long-awaited event is the launch of the James Webb telescope
It's been a great year, and may the next one be even better! Happy New Year 2022 to all of you!
